title: Card Survival RPG
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
Last Stop: BRIGHTSIDE, a card survival RPG set in a post-apocalyptic Arizona wasteland with a 1950s roadside Americana style.

You scavenge supplies, craft equipment, fight mutated creatures, and rebuild an abandoned town into a home for survivors. The free demo is available now.

How Al was used

Codex&Claude: Writing and revising GDScript, implementing gameplay systems and Ul, debugging, running automated checks, and preparing builds and trailer tooling.

PixelLab: Creating pixel art, sprite animations, and VEX.

Suno: BGM

FREE 30 ingame days DEMO browser, Windows, and Mac versions.  
https://neverrestenjoyer.itch.io/last-stop-brightside
